task_description: Write a method in Dafny to check if the elements of a given integer array are unique or not.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method AllElementsUnique(a: array<int>) returns (result: bool)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - If the method returns true, all elements in the array are distinct (no duplicates)
- If the method returns false, there exists at least one element that appears more than once in the array
